title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister highlighting the vital role of teachers in guiding learners from information towards wisdom
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by the Union Minister for Education, Shri Pralhad Joshi.
The Prime Minister noted that the Union Minister writes that India's continuing tradition of celebrating teachers reflects the deep respect accorded to those who impart knowledge. He added that the article highlights the teacher's vital role in guiding the learner from information towards understanding and from understanding towards wisdom, pointing out that the National Education Policy 2020 represents a significant step in this direction by placing the learner at the centre of education.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Union Education Minister Shri @JoshiPralhad writes that India's continuing tradition of celebrating teachers reflects the deep respect accorded to those who impart knowledge.
He highlights the teacher's vital role in guiding the learner from information towards understanding and from understanding towards wisdom. The National Education Policy 2020, he says, represents a significant step in this direction, placing the learner at the centre of education.”
